decks.notes: This deck focuses on quickly getting powerful creatures into the graveyard and then reanimating them to overwhelm the opponent. It utilizes cards like Entomb and Reanimate to quickly bring back high-impact creatures like Archon of Cruelty and Troll of Khazad-dûm. The deck also includes disruptive spells like Daze and Force of Will to protect its combo pieces and disruption lands like Wasteland to control the opponent's mana base. By efficiently cycling through the deck with Brainstorm and Ponder, the deck can consistently assemble its combo pieces and win the game in a quick and explosive fashion.

This Legacy Lands control deck focuses on using lands as resources to disrupt the opponent's game plan while building up a powerful board state. With cards like Crop Rotation, Life from the Loam, Exploration, and Wasteland, the deck aims to control the board and disrupt the opponent's mana base. The deck also includes combo pieces such as Dark Depths and Thespian's Stage for a quick win condition. The inclusion of cards like Sphere of Resistance and Tabernacle at Pendrell Vale further adds to the control aspect of the deck. The deck utilizes lands in unique ways to dominate the game.

The deck focuses on combining cards like Dark Ritual, Doomsday, and Lotus Petal to set up a winning pile with Thassa's Oracle. It also includes various disruption spells like Thoughtseize, Force of Will, and Stifle to protect the combo. The deck relies on efficient cantrips like Brainstorm and Ponder to dig for combo pieces, while also utilizing land disruption with Wasteland and Daze. Personal Tutor can search for key combo pieces, while Orcish Bowmasters provide additional disruption. Overall, the deck aims to quickly assemble its combo and win the game in a single turn.

The main concept of this Grixis Aggro deck is to aggressively control the board and disrupt the opponent's strategy by utilizing a mix of control spells and aggressive creatures. The deck aims to quickly establish dominance through efficient removal, counter spells, and hard-hitting creatures like Murktide Regent, Brazen Borrower, and Troll of Khazad-dûm. By combining disruption with aggression, the deck seeks to overpower the opponent and secure a victory through a combination of powerful control and beatdown tactics.

The deck focuses on disrupting the opponent's game plan by using counter spells, removal, and land destruction. It also aims to draw cards and control the board with various threats such as Leovald, Murktide Regent, and Uro. The deck can generate card advantage with cards like Brainstorm and Mystic Sanctuary, and utilize powerful removal spells like Fatal Push and Murderous Cut. By controlling the game through card advantage, disruption, and threats, the deck aims to outvalue the opponent and win through incremental advantage.

This deck focuses on disrupting opponents with cards like Blood Moon, Chalice of the Void, and Trinisphere, while also quickly deploying threats like Goblin Rabblemaster and Broadside Bombardiers. The goal is to lock down the opponent's mana base and disrupt their game plan, while quickly closing out the game with aggressive creatures and burn spells. The deck aims to put pressure on the opponent early and maintain control of the game with its disruptive elements, ultimately overwhelming the opponent and securing a victory.

The main concept of this deck is to quickly apply pressure to the opponent using cheap and efficient creatures such as Delver of Secrets and Dragon's Rage Channeler, while disrupting their game plan with cards like Thoughtseize, Force of Will, and Wasteland. The deck aims to control the board with removal spells like Lightning Bolt and counter spells like Daze, while building card advantage with Brainstorm and Ponder. The deck also utilizes powerful threats like Murktide Regent and Brazen Borrower to close out the game quickly before the opponent can stabilize.

The main focus of this deck is to quickly overwhelm the opponent with a rush of aggressive goblin creatures. By utilizing powerful cards like Muxus, Goblin Grandee and Goblin Rabblemaster, the deck aims to flood the board with threats while also disrupting the opponent's game plan with cards like Chalice of the Void. With a combination of mana acceleration from cards like Ancient Tomb and Simian Spirit Guide, as well as tribal synergies from cards like Goblin Matron and Goblin Warchief, this deck aims to quickly pressure the opponent and secure a fast victory.

This Legacy 1 vs 1 Combo deck revolves around quickly ramping up mana using cards like Tinder Farm and Ancient Tomb, in order to cast powerful spells such as Creative Technique and Throes of Chaos to cheat out big creatures like Emrakul, the Aeons Torn and Apex Devastator. The deck also utilizes cards like Violent Outburst and Maelstrom Wanderer to cascade into more spells and keep the pressure on opponents. By overwhelming opponents with massive creatures and unexpected plays, this deck aims to win the game in a dramatic fashion.

The deck revolves around assembling the Dark Depths combo using Thespian's Stage to create a 20/20 flying indestructible Marit Lage token. It also utilizes cards such as Crop Rotation, Green Sun's Zenith, and Elvish Reclaimer to search for combo pieces and control the opponent's board with cards like Swords to Plowshares and Wasteland. The deck includes various ways to protect the combo, such as Sylvan Safekeeper and Maze of Ith, along with additional synergies like Knight of the Reliquary and Flagstones of Trokair to further support the strategy.

The deck focuses on utilizing a variety of control spells and card advantage to disrupt the opponent's strategy while maintaining a strong board presence. It has a mix of removal, counterspells, and card draw to control the game tempo. The inclusion of powerful creatures like Uro, Titan of Nature's Wrath and Orcish Bowmasters provides additional threats and value. The mana base is built to support a diverse range of spells, allowing for flexibility in adapting to different matchups. Overall, the deck aims to outlast the opponent and win through attrition and strategic decision-making.

The main focus of this deck is to control the game by disrupting opponents' strategies through counterspells, removal spells, and land destruction. The deck aims to play a reactive game, using cards like Force of Will and Spell Pierce to counter key spells, while also utilizing cards like Fatal Push and Murderous Cut to deal with opposing threats. The deck also includes powerful finishers like Murktide Regent to close out the game. By controlling the board and disrupting opponents' plans, this deck seeks to outmaneuver and outlast opponents in a battle of attrition.

The main concept of this Goblins aggro deck is to swarm the board with fast and aggressive Goblin creatures while disrupting the opponent with cards like Chalice of the Void. The deck aims to quickly overpower the opponent with a combination of powerful Goblin lords like Muxus, Goblin Grandee and pump effects like Battle Cry Goblin. The inclusion of cards like Chrome Mox and Simian Spirit Guide allow the deck to play threats ahead of schedule, while lands like Ancient Tomb and City of Traitors help ramp out the deck's key threats.

The deck focuses on controlling the opponent's resources and disrupting their game plan by utilizing lands as both mana sources and tools for disruption. It aims to lock down the opponent's options by utilizing cards like Wasteland, Ghost Quarter, and Thespian's Stage to limit their mana production and strip away key lands. Additionally, the deck can assemble the Thespian's Stage/Dark Depths combo to generate a powerful 20/20 creature token. The inclusion of cards like Sphere of Resistance and The Tabernacle at Pendrell Vale also hinders the opponent's ability to develop their board and apply pressure.

The deck focuses on creating a disruptive control strategy utilizing a variety of counter spells, removal, and powerful planeswalkers to dominate the game. By controlling the board state and manipulating the opponent's plays, the deck aims to establish a commanding position and slowly grind out the win. The creatures included offer additional value and utility, while the mana base is carefully constructed to ensure consistency and access to all necessary colors. Overall, the deck aims to outmaneuver and outlast opponents in a battle of attrition, emerging victorious through careful planning and strategic plays.

This aggressive Canadian Threshold deck aims to quickly establish a board presence with efficient threats like Delver of Secrets, Dragon's Rage Channeler, and Murktide Regent while disrupting opponents with countermagic like Force of Will and Daze. The deck's mana denial plan is supported by Wasteland and interaction like Lightning Bolt and Chain Lightning to finish off opponents quickly. The deck seeks to control the tempo of the game and apply pressure on opponents while maintaining a strong board presence.
